purpose: Design for how doc-link fixes the indexing targets, confirms and issues DLIDs, and builds the ToC: inputs, argument rules, target expansion, change sets, candidate validation, and atomic publication.
summary: Inputs and outputs of a build and its execution boundary; a build never rewrites indexed documents
Target resolution: argument combination rules, directory and pattern expansion, exclusion matching, fixed exclusions
Path normalization, Markdown detection, symlink handling, and handling of missing or non-Markdown paths
ID confirmation: documents without an ID or with duplicate IDs are excluded from the confirmed target list and reported
DLID issuing operation: explicit invocation, counts-only result, duplicate resolution by original, section ID issuing
DLID format (60-bit random Crockford Base32, 12 characters), probabilistic uniqueness, and rollback rules
Change set determination at document and section level (added, deleted, moved, heading change, body change)
Update planning, reuse of AI-generated document information, and candidate validation before publication
Write units: atomic os.replace of document information and ToC, no locking, failure and re-execution behavior
tasks: Implementing or changing the index-docs build script
Implementing or changing the embed-dlid operation
Designing target specification and exclusion handling
Reviewing DLID issuing and duplicate resolution behavior
Implementing change set detection for ToC and sections
Reviewing write atomicity and failure handling of indexing
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
